scope: All pairs in the finite542-root event bank, numerical native Coxeter classification and intrinsic finite-intersection tests. Nonright finite coincidences use the stricter1e-10 cosine tolerance; loose1e-7 matches are separately recorded. The all-bank halfspace intersection ignores mutual incompatibility and is only an optimistic geometric relaxation. No continuous family or all-label completion claim; exactification is required for any chosen pair.
